job.title: Software Development Engineer I, Inference Models Optimization, AWS Neuron Inference
job.pay_full: $127,100 – $185,000 a year base salary (Cupertino), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Annapurna Labs at Amazon Web Services builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software that runs deep learning and generative AI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning chips. This entry-level role sits on the Model Enablement team in Neuron Inference, which gets large language models running and tuned on Trainium, working alongside compiler and runtime engineers and directly with customers.
duties: Optimize open models to run best on Trainium, including sharding, writing NKI kernels and checking accuracy
Work with hardware, firmware, compiler, runtime and ML engineers on software for custom ML accelerator chips
Write clean, maintainable C/C++, Python or Rust for performance-critical systems
Take part in code reviews and documentation, and help deploy agentic tools that speed up enabling new models
Monitor, debug and fix issues across the hardware-software boundary, including on-call duties
Keep learning about ML accelerators, compilers, computer architecture and distributed systems
needs: Experience with data structures, basic algorithms and/or object-oriented design
A Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field (completed or in progress)
Experience with a programming language such as Python, Java or C++
nice: Previous technical internships or project experience
Experience with compilers, computer architecture, hardware simulation, PyTorch or JAX, performance profiling, Linux kernel or embedded systems, cloud platforms (preferably AWS) or version control
Strong problem solving and debugging across hardware and software
Ability to learn new technologies quickly
details.benefits: Base salary $127,100 – $185,000 a year (Cupertino). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Entry-level role (Software Engineer I) on a team that says it supports new members with mentorship
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
